scope: Greatwood obstruction validation only; no change to spawn rolls, overall terrain, silverwood or big magic tree validation

evidence.behavior: Only vanilla air or TC greatwood leaves pass the line check.
An obstacle at distance <6 fails before writes; an obstacle at distance >=6 shortens heightLimit.

before: Shared replaceable() let greatwood validate through all leaves, replaceable plants and saplings.
after: Greatwood opts into strictGreatwoodLines. Both trunk and branch checkLine use air/its own leaves. Write-time replacement and other tree classes are unchanged.
